name: 90022 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90022 (Los Angeles) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90022 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 37 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
